description: Turn research papers, methods, mechanisms, systems, experiments, and user concepts into rigorous, copy-ready prompts for AI image generation of non-data scientific diagrams. Use for method/framework figures, model and system architectures, mechanism/pathway illustrations, research workflows, experimental setup schematics, graphical abstracts, conceptual diagrams, taxonomies, comparison narratives, and reference-guided scientific figures. Also use for 科研绘图提示词、论文方法图、机制图、机理图、技术路线图、 实验流程图、装置示意图、网络结构图、图形摘要、参考图风格迁移。 Deliver prompts first; optionally generate via host tools or configured APIs. Do not use for quantitative charts, plots, or for drawing/rebuilding the final editable figure in Illustrator, PowerPoint, or Visio.
